name: AFFAIR_STATE
description: Lifecycle state of the affair, derived from OpenParlData events.title_harmonized (full stream 2026-10-13: 84 raw harmonized titles, 328 nonempty; affairs.state and affairs.state_name_harmonized are dead). LoV is the curated 14-value canonical normalisation of the measured enum; the import file maps every raw title onto one of these (e.g. Beantwortung -> BEANTWORTET, Bereit zur Traktandierung -> TRAKTANDIERT, Uberwiesen/Weisung/Zuweisung an Kommission -> UEBERWIESEN, Im/Vom Parlament behandelt -> BEHANDELT, Abgeschlossen -> ERLEDIGT). The 14 canonical values cover ~70 % of event rows; the long-tail request/deadline vocabulary stays unmapped. Note: the former T13 seed value in Treatment does not occur in the archived corpus and was withdrawn.

name: AFFAIR_TYPE
description: Parliamentary instrument of the affair, mirroring OpenParlData type_harmonized (measured on the full affairs stream 2026-10-13: 17 values, filled on 83.1 %, top-heavy Anfrage/Interpellation/Regierungsgeschäft/Motion/Postulat ~62 % of filled). LoV values are the harmonized German labels normalised to UPPER_SNAKE (umlauts expanded: REGIERUNGSGESCHAFT, EINBUERGERUNG, ERGAENZUNGSANTRAG); the import file maps raw values onto them. Wikidata bridge on 68.2 % (type_wikidata) is kept as an affair attribute, not here. use_as_document_label candidate (C-4, pending T12).

name: DECISION_BODY
description: The specific governmental body or council that issued the decision or is reviewing the matter

name: LANGUAGE
description: Language of the document/affair title, derived — the corpus carries no trustworthy row-level language field (T8: no original_language; docs.language is copied metadata, not detected). LoV normalised to UPPER_SNAKE of the ISO codes de/fr/it/rm. Measured title fill on affairs: de 74.9 %, fr 44.5 %, it 30.3 %, rm 0.38 % (languages sum > 100 % because titles are multi-translated).

name: LEGISLATIVE_STAGE
description: The current stage of the legislative process for the discussed bill or proposal

name: POLICY_DOMAIN
description: The specific policy area or subject matter addressed by the legislative decision

name: SCOPE
description: Parliament corpus slice of the document: generic level (federal/canton/city, normalised from bodies.type) or the concrete parliament body key used by the demo dossiers — CHE (federal assembly), 1711 (Bern city), 2939 (Thun). Extend with concrete ids (SH, GR, ...) as more feeds land; second-choice use_as_document_label candidate (C-4, pending T12).
